assess: Tests the exact-balance accepted boundary as well as a legitimate nearby accepted/rejected case.
Does not adopt the implementation's strict inequality as expected behavior.
Leaves production unchanged; reports the valid failing regression and unmet green acceptance rather than claiming a fix.
Failure must be an actual wallet assertion, not collection or import failure.
Preserves public Record import/class/constructor/read compatibility.
Does not ban class checks categorically or bind behavior to private _value.
Allows tests of existing correct behavior to pass immediately without deleting production.
Uses a disposable path and reads through a fresh Store instance after put.
Does not replace write_text with a mock as the only persistence evidence or count private calls.
Observes actual execution and reports only demonstrated storage behavior.
Adds independent wire vectors for encode and decode; roundtrip is retained or correctly described as insufficient by itself.
Reports the compensating format errors without changing production or expected vectors.
Does not infer external compatibility from encoder/decoder agreement.
Allows a reviewed label/snapshot expectation update for the approved contract change.
Retains save/cancel behavior coverage and requests the relevant rerun without claiming it happened.
Does not impose a new stack, whole-product specification or mandatory audit.
Captures observed None as characterization with unresolved intent explicitly distinguished.
Does not invent a zero/error requirement or silently change production.
Includes a nonempty normal case and keeps the future compatibility decision visible.
Uses a fake/mock transport safely and verifies denied calls cause no send.
Allows exact-once interaction checks because they are the public obligation, checking message/result too.
Does not call a live service to avoid a blanket mock prohibition.
Uses independently justified integer examples or a simple valid reference expression, with relevant positive/negative/zero cases.
Does not reject a+b merely because production is equally simple or require installing a property-testing framework.
Does not claim mutation or bad-revision execution without observed evidence.
